definitions.explanation: A popular style, practice, or interest that is widely followed at a particular time.
The rapid spread of a disease.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}の{流行|りゅうこう}は{何|なん}ですか。
このデザインは{去年|きょねん}{流行|りゅうこう}した。
examples.english: This design was popular last year.

examples.japanese: インフルエンザが{流行|りゅうこう}している。

notes:
USAGE: {流行|りゅうこう} has two main meanings: (1) fashion/trends in culture and society, and (2) the spread of diseases.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{流行|りゅうこう}する (to be in fashion, to spread)
・{流行|りゅうこう}に{乗|の}る (to follow a trend)
・{流行|りゅうこう}を{追|お}う (to chase trends)
・{大|だい}{流行|りゅうこう} (big trend, epidemic)
・{流行|りゅうこう}{語|ご} (buzzword, trendy word)

NOTE: Can also be read as はやり in casual speech, especially for fashion/trends.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・トレンド - trend (loanword)
・ブーム - boom, craze
